objective: Add additive auth, billing, and runtime metadata to EXEC.json and proof bundle surfaces so future dopeTask report/TUI code can honestly render auth_mode, bare_mode_used, permission_mode, allowed_tools, and model routing metadata.

schema_updates.change: Added optional auth_mode, bare_mode_used, permission_mode, and allowed_tools properties.
Added optional runtime object with auth and model metadata properties.

runtime_updates.change: Reads raw proof metadata and emits auth_mode, bare_mode_used, permission_mode, and allowed_tools into EXEC.json additively.
Adds optional runtime metadata block to proof bundles when raw proof metadata exists.
Makes Claude proof metadata pass-through explicit without changing Claude command invocation.
